name: Findmeproject
description: A unified academic project showcase platform designed for G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering (GHRCE) to exhibit student innovations, promote research, and connect tomorrow's engineers with industry leaders. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), MongoDB, and NextAuth.

paragraphs: A unified academic project showcase platform designed for G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering (GHRCE) to exhibit student innovations, promote research, and connect tomorrow's engineers with industry leaders. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), MongoDB, and NextAuth.
features: Excel Batch Import: Seamless parsing of .xlsx and .xls files via SheetJS (xlsx) with automatic field mapping and server-side Zod validation.
Secure Authentication: Protected routes (/dashboard, /add-project, /edit-project) guarded by JWT-based NextAuth credentials strategy.
Strict input schemas using Zod validation.
Safe MongoDB queries with password values excluded (select: false) by default.
